text.first_seen: Ok, I know everyone raves about the quality, and Yeti is the 'to go' product. HOWEVER, the quality of this new $35 purchase is not the same as my 2016 20oz Stainless Steel - not even close. There are two items I have lost in my travels these last few years (which I have had for 10+Yrs) - my Mink wrap scarf and my 2016 YETI! One was a cost issue, and the Yeti was my everyday cold water/ICE quality container (at hm and travelling) This newer model, just purchased, and within 20 minutes, I knew this was not the quality of the 2016 Yeti. 1) It is lighter 2) You can feel the temp (Cold) on the outside 3) It does not retain ICE - as expected. *my older version would have ice in the container the next morning. And the older lid did not have the slide cover. And this was an authorized Yeti seller, so as I know this new version is not a fake.
